decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the established map.apps platform, has had rapid releases, and costs little to maintain, so it meets the aspiration and gives no reason for problemistic search.
This small plugin is close to the core offer, and the slack of a medium, R&D-active firm lets it be carried at low cost even though the website shows only a mention.
The mobile layer control was featured on the home page and improves usability on mobile devices; it may later be folded into newer components but is unlikely to be withdrawn within a year.
As the flagship platform line that defines the firm's direction, it anchors the aspiration level and will be kept.
Mobile field data capture is close to the core offer and serves public-sector and utility customers with steady demand, so performance likely meets the aspiration.
The search extension for web map apps is presented on its own page, adds to the core platform, and is cheap to sustain, so there is no shortfall that calls for dropping it.
